Start Animating! The Easiest Face Rig in Blender

Community Reporter · September 29, 2026

Learn face rigging with Kenan Proffitt.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

In this Blender tutorial, I’ll show you how to create an expressive face rig in Blender using a simple, beginner-friendly setup. I’ll walk through the tips and tricks I use to get a character ready for facial animation without building an overly complicated rig.
